mapper.select: SELECT sku, sku_name, sku_type, spec, unit, remark, use_yn, tax_yn FROM tb_sku_master

SELECT sku.sku , sku.sku_name , sku.sku_type , sku.spec , sku.unit , prc.unit_price , sku.tax_yn FROM tb_sku_master sku JOIN tb_unit_price_master prc ON sku.company_code = prc.company_code AND sku.sku = prc.sku WHERE prc.unit_price_type = 'SELL_UNIT' AND sku.use_yn = 'Y'
AND sku.sku like '%' || #{sku} || '%'
AND sku.sku_name like '%'|| #{skuName} ||'%'
